title: Directed fractal percolation and non-Lipschitz variants
summary: While models of undirected and directed geometry in random i.i.d. disorder with rapidly decaying tails are expected to behave similarly and exhibit features of the Kardar--Parisi--Zhang universality class, the scenario when the background noise is fractal is expected to be significantly different. A canonical example of the latter is Liouville Quantum Gravity, where the planar Gaussian free field forms the fractal background.
